Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 503 AM EDT Sun Oct 25 2026

- A Dense Fog Advisory is in effect until 10 AM for SE Michigan, 
except for the Tri Cities and northern Thumb. 

- There is potential for more dense fog Monday morning with similar 
late morning dissipation timing. 

- High temperatures increase to around 70 today before a dry cold 
front drops readings back into the upper 50s to low 60s Monday and 
Tuesday. 

- Dry weather continues through the middle of next week.

&&

.AVIATION...

A light low level south to southeast flow is supporting low level 
moisture plume off Lake Erie this morning and is resulting in dense 
fog development and LIFR conditions. Low level flow will promote a 
northward expansion with time this morning, though less confidence 
in dense fog with northward extent. Persistence forecast suggests 
the likelihood remains high enough to maintain LIFR in the forecast 
for all locations. Standard improvement in conditions where fog 
becomes dense during the late morning hours. VFR/clear skies then 
prevail into the afternoon and evening. Increasing coverage of 
clouds begins to draw in from the north tonight along with a frontal 
boundary and a northerly wind shift reach MBS and FNT late tonight 
and eventually the southern metro terminals mid-late Monday morning.

D21/DTW Convection... Thunderstorms are not forecast through the TAF 
period.

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* High for cigs/vsby below 200 ft and/or 1/2SM this morning.
